ticket.title: storypole verify --dir <member> writes Silver traces to <member>/spool/outbox.jsonl instead of the canonical .gaugeblock spool
ticket.description: Reproduced 2026-11-06 while certifying eleven delivered tickets. Running 'storypole verify GB-28 --dir storypole' created storypole/spool/outbox.jsonl (592 bytes, one silver trace) and the same happened in outfeed/, benchwork/ and chalkline/ - four stray spool directories in four repositories, none of them canonical. The root-ledger verifies wrote to .gaugeblock/spool/ as expected, so the defect is only on the --dir path. Likely the spool path is derived from the store root instead of GaugeblockPaths, which is the same class of bug GB-189 exists to remove. Leaked into the working tree as untracked directories that a 'git add -A' would commit.
